videos.title: Your Skeleton Is Electric
videos.author: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
videos.description:
Every step you take creates tiny electrical signals inside your bones. You’ll never charge your phone with them, but they may help tell your skeleton where it needs to grow stronger.

videos.title: How ADHD Medication Works
videos.author: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
videos.description:
ADHD medication doesn’t simply give your brain more dopamine. It changes how dopamine signals are processed, making it easier to resist immediate distractions and stick with rewards that take longer to reach.
